10.1002_adfm.79096: The upcycling of spent lithium‐ion batteries and waste plastics is critical for resource security and sustainable development. However, current recycling paradigms treat these waste streams separately, leading to energy‐intensive battery recovery and low‐value plastic downcycling. Here, we present a waste polyethylene‐driven hydrocarbothermal reduction strategy for upcycling spent LiNi 0.6 Co 0.2 Mn 0.2 O 2 (NCM 622 ) cathodes by exploiting the dual functions of plastics as in situ carbon sources and reducing agents, making a breakthrough on their co‐processing and joint upcycling, and constructing a closed‐loop system integrating mixed‐waste upcycling, water purification, and lithium recycling. Hydrocarbothermal reduction via polyethylene pyrolysis induces pronounced interlayer expansion and octahedral distortion within NCM 622 , triggering structural collapse and driving the formation of a stable NiCoMn alloy nanorod deposited on a carbon nanosheet (NiCoMn/C) catalyst. Kinetic analysis shows that Co sites act as the primary catalytic centers, while Ni and Mn mediate charge transfer. NiCoMn/C enables efficient peroxymonosulfate (PMS) activation for bisphenol A degradation with a rate constant of 0.411 min −1 , demonstrating competitive catalytic performance among reported alloy–carbon catalysts. Meanwhile, this system achieves 87% lithium recovery, reduced greenhouse gas emissions, and strong economic viability. This work establishes a generalizable paradigm for integrated waste‐to‐resource conversion and environmental remediation.
10.1016_j.est.2025.120129: Considering the promising prospects of retired battery cells in second-life utilization, it is imperative to enhance their consistency through sorting. However, existing sorting algorithms are susceptible to human factors and overlook the impact of battery pack busbar positions on recycling efficiency in second-life applications. Therefore, we propose a novel scheme for sorting and reusing retired batteries. To ensure the reliability of sorting characteristic parameters, the Pearson correlation coefficient was employed to verify the redundancy among them. Additionally, an FCE-KM sorting method integrating fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) and K-means algorithm (KM) was put forward. This method determines the weights of sorting characteristic parameters via FCE based on the entropy weight method and identifies initial cluster centers from evaluation results, effectively avoiding human factor influences. Experimental results show that among the sorting characteristic parameters, capacity exhibits a strong negative correlation with open-circuit voltage and a moderate negative correlation with internal resistance, while open-circuit voltage and internal resistance show a weak positive correlation. These relationships effectively eliminate information redundancy among sorting characteristic parameters and ensure the reliability of selected parameters. Compared with the KM, the proposed method reduces the average consistency score by 16.52%, the number of iterations by 40%, and the average value of clustering inertia by 29%, thereby reducing sorting costs and improving the consistency and accuracy of sorting results. Furthermore, according to the capacity ranges of batteries in each level from sorting results and their relationships with busbar positions, a strategy for second-life utilization allocation based on battery capacity and a strategy for battery pack recycling based on busbar positions are proposed.
10.1021_acsami.5c17916: Aqueous zinc-ion batteries (AZIBs) are considered among the most promising energy storage systems because of their low cost, high safety, and high theoretical capacity. However, challenges including Zn 2+ desolvation, side reactions, and dendritic growth significantly hinder their rate capability and cycling stability. In this study, we propose a molecule-substitution-induced anchoring strategy by introducing kojic acid molecules with carbon-based (C═O) and hydroxyl (C–OH) groups to modulate the Zn 2+ solvation structure, lower the desolvation activation energy, and effectively suppress undesirable side reactions. More importantly, its pyranone ring (C–O–C) can anchor onto the Zn surface to form an adsorption layer, which induces the uniform deposition of Zn 2+ ions and consequently suppresses dendrite formation. At a current density of 1 mA cm –2 and an areal capacity of 1 mAh cm –2, the symmetric cell demonstrated an ultralong lifespan of 2800 h and a high Coulombic efficiency of 99.72%. Furthermore, the assembled Zn||δ-MnO 2 full cell had a capacity retention of 95% after 1500 cycles at 3 A g –1 . Even at an elevated temperature of 50 °C, the cell retained a capacity of 197.9 mAh g –1 after 200 cycles.
10.1039_d5ta10228f: Well-faceted single-particle Ni-rich NCM(LiNi 0.92 Co 0.03 Mn 0.05 O 2 ) cathodes were synthesized via molten-salt calcination. This study correlates precursor morphology-driven particle shape, size, and facets directly to electrochemical characteristics.
